assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse liver (BGISEQ-500; HISAT/Bowtie2/RSEM)

group: Ath diet + 8 wk treadmill aerobic exercise (EXE)

sample_inclusion: paper: n=8/group randomized (S2.1.p1); RNA-seq on liver tissues of each group (S3.2.p1); GEO deposits 3/group
primary_estimand: effect of 8 weeks aerobic treadmill exercise on the liver transcriptome of Ath-diet NASH mice: NASH+Exercise vs NASH sedentary (S3.2.p1, FIG3B)
planned_contrasts: EXE+Ath vs Ath sedentary (S3.2.p1; paper: 204 DEGs, 79 up / 125 down; Dio1 up)
Ath (NASH) vs NCD control (S3.2.p2, FIG3D/E; GO and GSEA only, no DEG count given)
paper_method: DESeq2 (R); GO via DAVID on up/down DEGs; GSEA Hallmark/GO (S2.6.p1)
paper_results: 204 DEGs EXE vs NASH (79 up, 125 down); Dio1 up; GSEA in EXE vs NASH: inflammatory/IFN/TNFa/IL6 negative, OXPHOS positive, TGF-beta negative
